technical_summary: Initial evaluation used Redwood Hosted API for dev integration. Now moving to Dedicated POC to validate predictable latency at scale and isolate data. Key asks: VPC deployment, KMS key ownership, audit logging retention, and ability to run canary traffic and automatic fallback to smaller/cheaper model variants or alternative region on overload. Want deterministic unit costs and guidance on batching/quantization for their production prompts.

KMS integration test and audit log capture to SIEM
